messages.author: b330c2028fed415b
messages.subject: mirt 0.8.0 released to CRAN
parts:
Dear all,

I've released the latest version of mirt to CRAN. For an abridged
version of the new features/bug fixes either navigate to the NEWS file
in the html documents, or type the following after updating:

utils::news(Version == '0.8.0', package = 'mirt')

I'd also like to take this opportunity to announce that mirt was
fortunate enough to win the John Chambers R software award for 2013,
which I'll be receiving next month in Montreal. Thanks to all who have
sent bug reports and given suggestions in the past; the package
wouldn't be where it is now without all the user support and
encouragement. Cheers!

Phil
